steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: That was fast... an observation station of this size, built in such a short period of time...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Business must have cried tears of blood when they approved the budget.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Actually, we got more sponsorship offers from financial institutions than we could handle the moment the committee approved the Kjerag observation station.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: If anything, funding was the least of our worries on this project.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Honestly, Silence... I didn't expect the committee to approve the proposal that easily.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I had my reservations. I still think Rhine Lab is too adventurous with regard to research into the Starpod. There are numerous potential risks that we have not fully considered.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But I also recognize that the stability I hope for may never come.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: At the end of the day, it's the specific people in whom we place our trust.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Well then... thank you for your trust, Silence of the Scientific Ethics Consensus Committee.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I hope what we're doing is worth it...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Of course it is. This station is a unique opportunity for the company.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: In addition to the Starpod research, the low-Originium environment of Kjerag also offers a rare opportunity for biological research. Not to mention Maryam has wanted to visit Karlan for ages!

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Even Ferdinand came up with the proposal for the station's core power supply just two weeks after we got approval.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Of course, he buried his head in his theoretical research right after that. Elena from Energy is handling the actual implementation.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Let's hope our interactions with Kjerag go as smoothly.
I believe there will be no need to worry about that.
The door to the observation station opens from the outside. The visitor flicks away the snow that has fallen on his shoulders and walks in.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: We meet again, Mr. Edelweiss.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Just a regular visit to see if you need anything for the construction of the station.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: It seems like things are progressing quite smoothly.
Gnosis looks up at the bright lights installed on the spacious ceiling of the station.
Rhine Lab and Karlan Trade have worked together to build this little temple, sturdy and bright, in an astonishingly short period of time.
Compared to the houses of Kjerag, its bold, futuristic design might as well have come from another world.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Karlan Trade will do everything in our power to assist Rhine Lab's observation project, and provide any assistance necessary outside of the scope of work.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: As long as the terms agreed in the treaty are upheld, you will enjoy maximum freedom to conduct your activities in Kjerag.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Thank you for your generosity, Mr. Edelweiss.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Research has always been the sole purpose of Rhine Lab. We have no reason to violate the treaty.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Of course... I believe as much.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Such transnational cooperation is unprecedented in the history of Terra. It will undoubtedly produce its share of obstacles...

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I simply wish to express that, as long as we proceed with due candor in the sharing of scientific information, we will be able to avoid the sort of accident that occurred in Trimounts.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Oh, I forgot to ask! Will the Saintess come and visit the station?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I expect she will attend the opening ceremony once the facility is complete... is there a particular reason why you hope to meet her?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Oh, nothing serious, I'm just a curious critter.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I kinda remember the Saintess wasn't too into our project, but then she flipped around and agreed, all of a sudden.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I just wanna know what made her change her mind, and I figured that'd be a chance to ask.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: The Saintess has a very busy schedule. If you wish to meet her, you may want to attend some local ceremonies... if the fancy strikes.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: The Saintess and the Vine-Bead Court would be very happy to receive you... let me know if you have such intentions, and I'll make the necessary arrangements.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Well, aren't you meticulous? You seem made for this job.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I'm simply showing you proper Kjerag hospitality.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: It's our mutual hope that this cooperation will be a fruitful one... free of trouble.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Much appreciated. Our project wouldn't be going so smoothly without your help.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I would not call it help... we are simply trying to achieve the same goal.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Karlan Trade will connect the mountains of Kjerag for you, paving the roads and providing the necessary freedom for your activities.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: In turn, Rhine Lab will share data from your studies of our local ecology, and assist with medical development.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: The contract details have to go between Director Fitzroy and Karlan Trade, of course.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I'm a researcher, not a diplomat. I just want you to know that Rhine Lab has come to this sacred place in good faith.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: On this, I think we are of the same mind.
They shake hands with nods and smiles, an image that could have served as a perfect press photo.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: There is no need to worry...

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: We will continue along as 'friends,' assuming we both abide by our agreement.

steps.name: Energy Section Researcher
steps.text: The representatives of Karlan Trade are here, Elena.

steps.name: Energy Section Researcher
steps.text: They want to meet a representative of Rhine Lab as soon as possible.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Why? We don't have any scheduled meetings with Karlan Trade, do we?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: ...Is it because of the Catastrophe?

steps.name: Energy Section Researcher
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Energy Section Researcher
steps.text: They want to discuss the cause, and at least obtain the data observed by the station.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Right...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Did you see Carolin anywhere? She's supposed to be in charge of the observation data, isn't she?

steps.name: Energy Section Researcher
steps.text: That's the other question I have for you.

steps.name: Energy Section Researcher
steps.text: No one's seen her since yesterday morning.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Men with guns surrounding the station, demanding that all our researchers gather in the lobby for 'questioning.'

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Is this how Karlan Trade treats its friends, Mr. Edelweiss?
The researchers stand around the spacious lobby in small groups.
Gnosis and the guards of Clan Silverash occupy the outside area near the door.
The two groups stand opposite one another, as though separated by an invisible river.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: It's a request, not a demand... and it seems that not all your researchers are accounted for.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Who exactly are you looking for?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: A researcher who was spotted in a restricted military zone of Kjerag.
Gnosis scans the faces of the researchers one by one.
The strong guards stand silently while the researchers exchange wordless gazes.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: ...She is not here.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: It seems that Rhine Lab is not fully aware of your researchers' whereabouts.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: If you're accusing us of espionage, I'll ask that you submit your complaint through the official channels.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: We are unable to cooperate with impromptu investigations like so.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Of course... there is another reason why I'm here.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I'm sure you've heard about the Catastrophe that occurred within Kjerag's borders several hours ago, something that has never before happened in our history.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Panic is spreading. The people's nerves are sensitive, and anything new may provoke a reaction... I'm sure you understand what I mean.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Should I trust that you're not one of the sensitive ones, Mr. Edelweiss?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: My views on this matter, and Karlan Trade's views, are not important at this time.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: What is important is that the people want an explanation. I hope to work together with you to find the cause of this Catastrophe.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I'm afraid you'll be disappointed.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I just checked the station's observation logs. There was nothing out of the ordinary in the seventy-two hours preceding the Catastrophe.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: So you're telling me that the observation station did not detect anything abnormal leading up to the first Catastrophe to strike this land in a thousand years?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: That's the truth, at least based on our observation data.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Elena?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It's alright. Mr. Edelweiss wants the truth. We'll give him the truth.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: The primary objective of this observation station is to study the Starpod.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Current research shows no relationship between the Starpod and Catastrophes.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Similarly, any assertion that building an observation station here might bring Catastrophe to Kjerag is purely speculative with no basis in evidence.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: (W-Wait a second, Elena! Now is not the time to be argumentative!)

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: May I be frank?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: ...You may.
The young woman's voice is calm, her gaze firm and unwavering.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I won't mince words, then.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: This may run contrary to the Kjerag faith, but from a scientific perspective, so-called 'sudden' Catastrophes are not an abnormal occurrence.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It is the peace and quiet that Kjerag has enjoyed for so long, and the attitude of taking it for granted, that is truly abnormal.
The lobby is completely quiet. Elena's words echo to the end of the corridor.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: When this observation station was first established, Rhine Lab considered adding a Catastrophe warning system.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Unfortunately, we placed too much trust in past experience, and did not consider the installation of this system to be a priority.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: If we are to take remedial measures...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: The real priority should be for Rhine Lab and Karlan Trade to go back to the negotiating table and establish an effective Catastrophe warning system in Kjerag as soon as possible.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: ...A most astute observation, Miss.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I agree completely. Karlan Trade will make developing a Catastrophe warning system a top priority.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: We would like to obtain a copy of the station's observation data from the past month... may we expect your cooperation?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: One moment, please.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I didn't know you had it in you, Elena.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Sorry, Director Muelsyse... was I too hot-headed?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: A little bit... maybe?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I was just angry at how science has to explain for perceptions that are completely unscientific, no matter where we are...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: We have to recognize that science can be a very distant thing for a lot of people.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: The people and the things that trouble us are part of this land. It's not something that we can ignore.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Like Silence said, 'Science is a clear, incisive look at every one of us.'

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I know... but this is just so absurd—

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Never mind that for now... let's get the data we need.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Data, data... it's not like we'll find anything...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Wait... this graph—
Elena picks up the scattered papers, and notices the shape of a certain curve on a spectrogram.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: This is impossible...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: This machine is used to study the Starpod's structure, by bombarding it with high-powered particle beams and observing the resulting electromagnetic radiation...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: But I just realized that the data obtained between 3-4 A.M. on December 7th is identical to the data from the same period on December 4th.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: An unusual coincidence?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: No... it's impossible.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Just like how no two snowflakes are completely alike, atmospheric electromagnetic radiation is constantly changing.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: There is only one possibility, if the exact same waveform is displayed during the same time period on two different days for an entire hour...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Someone altered these data.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Falsifying data to support a hypothesis? But people don't usually pull shenanigans like that until way later in a project...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Got any idea who might have done it?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: December 7th... the day before the Catastrophe...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: The one on observation duty was... Carolin.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Could it be...?
Angry shouts pierce through the metal walls.

steps.name: Villager's Voice
steps.text: Give Mount Karlan back to us! Back to Kjerag! Back to Kjeragandr!

steps.name: Villager's Voice
steps.text: Get off Kjeragandr's land!
